short: A device that reads a barcode and enters the item instantly.
seoTitle: Barcode Scanner — Meaning and Example for Businesses
metaDescription: A barcode scanner reads a printed barcode and enters the corresponding item into the billing screen. Part of the free Setu business glossary.
definition: A barcode scanner reads a printed barcode and enters the corresponding item into the billing screen. Most behave as keyboards, so they work with any software that accepts typed input.
bodyHtml:
Why Barcode Scanner matters

Scanning is faster than searching and, more importantly, accurate. Typed item entry produces wrong prices and wrong stock deductions in roughly equal measure.

How Barcode Scanner works in practice

Ensure every sellable item has a scannable code, including loose goods packed in store. Items without codes become the slow, error-prone path staff take under pressure.

faq.question: Do I need a special scanner for my software?
faq.answer: Most USB scanners emulate a keyboard and work with anything that accepts typed input.

faq.question: What about items without a barcode?
faq.answer: Print your own labels for loose or repacked goods so the whole range is scannable.
